name: 4-bit Sync Counter
spec: A 4-bit synchronous binary counter with active-high synchronous reset, an enable input (en), and an overflow output that goes high for one clock cycle when the counter wraps from 15 to 0. The counter only increments when en is high.

name: 8-bit Shift Register
spec: An 8-bit serial-in parallel-out (SIPO) shift register with active-high synchronous reset. On each clock edge (when shift_en is high), the register shifts left, accepting a new serial bit at serial_in. All 8 bits are available in parallel on data_out.

name: 2-to-1 Mux
spec: A parameterized 2-to-1 multiplexer with DATA_WIDTH defaulting to 8. Inputs are a and b; sel=0 selects a, sel=1 selects b. Output is y. Fully combinational, no clock or reset needed.

name: Traffic Light FSM
spec: A Moore FSM traffic light controller with three states: GREEN (10 cycles), YELLOW (3 cycles), RED (10 cycles). The FSM cycles GREEN→YELLOW→RED→GREEN. An emergency input immediately forces and holds the state to RED for as long as it is asserted. Outputs: red, yellow, green (one-hot). Active-high synchronous reset, resets to RED state.

name: 4-bit ALU
spec: A 4-bit combinational ALU with operations selected by a 3-bit op code: ADD (op=000), SUB (op=001), AND (op=010), OR (op=011), XOR (op=100), NOT A (op=101), pass-through A (op=110), pass-through B (op=111). Inputs: a[3:0], b[3:0], op[2:0]. Outputs: result[3:0], zero (high when result==0), carry_out (add/sub carry).
